slides.title: Same dumbbells since March.
slides.body: Same weight, same reps. Comfortable isn't progress.

slides.title: You adapt in weeks.
slides.body: Once a load stops being hard, it stops asking for change.

slides.title: One rep or 2.5kg more.
slides.body: Small jumps, every week. Boring wins.

slides.title: Write every set down.
slides.body: You can't beat last week if you don't know it.

slides.title: Last rep looked easy?
slides.body: Then it was. Go up next session.
